## Current subquestion 3.1
Determine the empirical formula of COF-1 and calculate the mass percentage (%, to two decimal places) of carbon in COF-1.

entry.answer: The empirical formula of COF-1 is C9H4BO2, its elemental composition is C – 12.01⋅9 12.01⋅9+4⋅1.008+10.81+32 ⋅100% = 69.77%; C: 69.77% Empirical formula: C9H4BO2 1 pt for empirical formula. No penalty for [C9H4BO2]𝑛 1 pt for C mass fraction. no penalty if integer values are used for atomic masses 2.0 pt
